2. Perused the recorded.

3. Applicant-Shivam Saxena, who is a charge sheeted accused, has approached this Court by means of present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. with the following prayer:-

sentences.text: On the matter being taken up, the learned A.G.A. submits that notice of this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been served upon first informant-opposite party-4 on 10.11.2024.

However,
in spite of service of notice, neither any counter affidavit has been filed by first informant-opposite party-4 nor any one has put in appearance on his behalf to oppose this application, even in revised call.
5.

Learned counsel for applicant submits that in view of the document occurring at page 45 and the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., which is at page 62 of the paper book, the prosecutrix shall be deemed to be major.
As such, no charge under Section 376 IPC and Sections 3/4 POCSO Act could have been framed against applicant.

He, therefore, submits that in view of above, the impugned framing of charge order, insofar as it relates to framing of charges under Section 376 IPC and Sections 3/4 POCSO Act against applicant cannot be sustained.
6. Per contra the learned A.G.A. representing State-opposite party-1 has vehemently opposed the present application.
Learned A.G.A. submits that the age of child can be determined only in accordance with the provisions contained in Section 94 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015.

entities.text: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: As per the scheme of Section 94 of aforementioned Act, the same is preferential in nature, meaning thereby that firstly the provisions of Section 94(a) shall be looked into.
In case, the conditions mentioned in aforesaid Sub-Section are not satisfied, Court can refer to Section 94(b).
In case, the conditions mentioned in Section 94(b) are also not available, only then as a last resort, the age of child can be determined as per the medical evidence.

With reference to the material on record, the learned A.G.A. thus contends that the documents relied upon by the learned counsel for applicant in support of the fact that the prosecutrix is major, are not covered within the ambit and scope of Section 94(a).
As such, no illegality can be attached to the framing of charge order passed by Court below, whereby charges under Section 376 IPC and Sections 3/4 POCSO Act has also been framed against applicant.

As such, no interference is warranted by this Court in this Shivam Saxena vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198564335/
2 application.
7.

entities.text: Shivam Saxena vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: When confronted with above, the learned counsel for applicant could not overcome the same.

8. Having heard the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State and upon perusal of record, this Court finds that the objections raised by the learned A.G.A. in opposition to this application are clearly borne out from the record and furthermore, the same could not be dislodged by the learned counsel for applicant with reference to the record.
As such, no good ground exists to entertain the present application.
9. As a result, the present application fails and is liable to be dismissed.
10. It is, accordingly, dismissed.
